name: Pacific Clam Chowder in Sourdough Bread Bowl
whyItWorks: Rich clam chowder loaded with heavy cream, butter, and bacon fat poured into a dense, chewy sourdough bowl. Concentrated lactose and dairy fat can stimulate severe loose stools in Crohn's patients.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Lactose & Fat Warning: Savor the sourdough bread exterior and only small spoonfuls of soup, or take lactase enzyme tablets.
